about.title: About us
about.lead: Button is a chain of men's clothing stores in Tashkent.
about.p1: We bring clothing from Turkey and China and sell it directly. The country of manufacture is stated openly on every product page — we have nothing to hide.
about.p2: The goal is simple: good clothes at a fair price. We are not a luxury store and do not pretend to be one. But the quality is noticeably better than the bazaar.
about.p3: This site exists so you can see prices. No need to travel to a mall to ask what something costs — the price, the sizes and which store has it are all here.
about.qualityText: We pick every item ourselves. If it is not good, it does not go on the shelf.
about.styleText: From formal to everyday — pieces that are easy to wear.
about.priceText: We do not hide the price. It is the first thing you see.
